column1: # Crop boxes for scripts/paper-figs.  TAB separated; lines starting with # are comments.
# page  is the 1-based physical PDF page (all three papers number their printed pages the same).
# x y w h  are PIXELS at 150 dpi, origin top-left — the -x -y -W -H of pdftoppm -r 150.
# lean_decl  is the fully qualified Lean declaration the clip is the source for, or "-" when the
#            figure is recorded for a phase that has no Lean yet (diag/Tape.lean, diag/FO.lean).
# Several rows may name the same declaration: an axiom stated twice in a paper gets both clips.
# Example 2.3(c), special Frobenius: (11) is the Frobenius equation, (12) the special law
# Definition 4.1 clause 3, the adjunction and Frobenius inequations
# Definition 4.1 clause 4, laxness — the same statements as eq. (3) on p. 4
# p. 18, the displayed derivation of the special law from (38) + (40) + the unit laws
# ---- Example 2.3(d)(e): the equations Def. 4.1 does NOT take ----------------------------------
# Bialgebra (13)–(16) and Hopf (17)–(19) combine the same monoid and comonoid a different way.
# Recorded so the omission is visibly deliberate, not an oversight; no Lean counterpart exists.
